mission_phase: Generation 37 - Verify status (confirmed/failed) + icon-based scoreboard presentation
phase_goal: Replace the browser-opening rerun link with an inline verify status (confirmed/failed) per case, and make the scoreboard cases icon-driven (colored severity dot + a check/cross verify icon) with minimal text. The dashboard cannot live-fetch bot-walled sites, so verify is a browser re-check result stamped on the case, not a live dashboard button.
reason_generation_started: Operator: rerun should not open a browser window; it should just confirm our reading is correct (confirmed/failed). Better presentation with icons, less text.
standing_directive: Verify = browser re-check comparing the fresh count to the recorded count (confirmed if within tolerance, failed/changed otherwise). A live re-check sample was run on Home Depot severe pairs (all matched). Do not fabricate; do not apply destructive cleanup.

functional: Each case shows a verify status (confirmed/failed) inline, not a link that opens a window.
Cases are icon-driven: a colored severity dot and a check/cross verify icon, minimal text.
A live re-check sample confirmed the recorded counts (Home Depot severe pairs matched within tolerance).
usability: Interactive walkthrough: open the scoreboard, cases read as icons with confirmed/failed; Shopify/Woo unaffected.
No inspection triggered; no server-side fetching.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts cases carry a verify status and the icon-based rendering is wired; gate green; git diff --check clean.
